# Support

- Use [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/baiyanwu/Whirl/discussions) for setup, usage, and troubleshooting questions.
- Use the bug-report form for a reproducible defect.
- Use the feature-request form for a focused product proposal.
- Follow [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) for suspected vulnerabilities; never disclose them in a public issue.

Support is provided on a best-effort basis. Include the Whirl version or commit, macOS version, Apple silicon family, and sanitized reproduction steps when asking for help.
